title_template: {work_unit_id} — Durable autonomous continuation session resume execution
goal: Exercise the canonical WU-115 durable resume contract across a controlled session handoff so continuation after the handoff is derived only from fresh provider truth and fresh WU-108/WU-109 recomputation, never from persisted admission, CI, CAS or merge-eligibility state.
scope: persist one canonical public-safe checkpoint at a clean iteration boundary and treat it only as a hint after a simulated session handoff
fresh-read current main, selected canonical Work Unit, provider-state registry, Writer Lease, branch, pull-request and exact-head CI truth after the handoff
prove persisted control-loop, execution-admission, CI-success and registry CAS observations are discarded and cannot authorize a resumed mutation
recompute fresh WU-108 and WU-109 decisions after the handoff before executing at most one exact delegated transaction
advance provider truth after the checkpoint and prove the stale checkpoint is superseded rather than replayed
exercise interrupted or readback-pending checkpoint semantics and prove provider reconciliation occurs before any resumed mutation
forbidden_scope: reuse checkpoint admission, Writer Lease ownership, registry CAS token, CI success or merge eligibility as resumed authority
assume an interrupted transaction completed or failed without fresh provider readback
batch multiple delegated provider mutations under one resumed admission or skip the WU-113 one-transaction-per-iteration contract
broaden existing reusable materialization, Writer Lease, autonomous merge/Issue-close, steady-state or session-resume authority
mutate product/runtime source or physical runtime, ADWF Consumer binding/provenance or the ADWF repository
perform release/tag/promotion, ruleset/policy administration, PRIVATE evidence publication or 1080/1081 lifecycle mutation
exit_criteria: a real clean-boundary checkpoint is resumed through fresh provider truth with all persisted decision state discarded
at least one post-handoff delegated transaction is admitted only by freshly recomputed WU-108/WU-109 decisions and is followed by mandatory provider readback
checkpoint/provider drift is detected and fresh provider truth wins deterministically
interrupted and provider-readback-pending states never replay a transaction and require reconciliation first
all checkpoint and resume evidence is public-safe and grants no direct mutation authority
exact-head hosted CI passes with no product/runtime, ADWF or 1080/1081 mutation
